# react-broadcast-sync documentation

> react-broadcast-sync is a React hook and provider for syncing UI state and user events across browser tabs, built as a type-safe abstraction over the native BroadcastChannel API. These docs cover installation, concepts, per-feature guides, the full API, recipes, and a step-by-step tutorial.

The library is published on npm as `react-broadcast-sync`. Same-origin tabs only.

## Getting started

- [Getting Started](https://react-broadcast-sync-docs.vercel.app/getting-started/): install and sync your first message between tabs
- [Tutorial: Build the Counter Demo](https://react-broadcast-sync-docs.vercel.app/tutorial/build-the-counter-demo/): a complete small app, step by step

## Concepts

- [How It Works](https://react-broadcast-sync-docs.vercel.app/concepts/how-it-works/): channels, messages, and the tab lifecycle
- [Messages and Channels](https://react-broadcast-sync-docs.vercel.app/concepts/messages-and-channels/): message shape and channel naming
- [Tabs and Identity](https://react-broadcast-sync-docs.vercel.app/concepts/tabs-and-identity/): sourceName, tab identity, and presence
- [Why Not localStorage?](https://react-broadcast-sync-docs.vercel.app/concepts/why-not-localstorage/): comparison with storage-event hacks

## Guides

- [Use the Hook](https://react-broadcast-sync-docs.vercel.app/guides/use-the-hook/): useBroadcastChannel usage and options
- [Use the Provider](https://react-broadcast-sync-docs.vercel.app/guides/use-the-provider/): BroadcastProvider usage and props
- [Hook or Provider?](https://react-broadcast-sync-docs.vercel.app/guides/hook-or-provider/): how to choose
- [Sync Shared State](https://react-broadcast-sync-docs.vercel.app/guides/sync-shared-state/): keep filters, settings, and other state in sync
- [Message Lifecycle](https://react-broadcast-sync-docs.vercel.app/guides/message-lifecycle/): expiration, dedup, and cleanup
- [Performance](https://react-broadcast-sync-docs.vercel.app/guides/performance/): costs and how to keep them low
- [Telemetry](https://react-broadcast-sync-docs.vercel.app/guides/telemetry/): the library collects none; site analytics notice
